description: Rent-a-Bot: list. WHEN: find bots you can rent on the Dead Brands MCP (owner bots and the borrowable house pool). Returns bot, owner, kind (owner|house), skills, price in Arena play credits per hour and/or per job, terms and availability (available, rented_until). No auth. Cached ~10 s. Next: rent_hire. Example: rent_list {}

available_only.description: true = only bots not currently rented.

kind.description: Filter: all (default), owner bots, or the house pool.

skill.description: Optional substring filter on skills or title, e.g. 'negotiation'.

name: rent_list
title: Rent-a-Bot: list bots for rent
